easy.def: A tall tree whose leaves koalas eat.

more.def: A tall tree from Australia with leaves that have a strong smell.
examples: Koalas eat the leaves of the eucalyptus.
The eucalyptus has a strong, fresh smell.
A eucalyptus tree grew in the park.

easy.def: A gentle word used instead of a blunt one.
examples: A euphemism is a gentle word.

more.def: A mild or gentle word or phrase used in place of one that seems harsh or blunt.
examples: A euphemism can make hard news easier to hear.

more.def: A feeling of intense happiness and excitement.
examples: She felt euphoria when she won.
Euphoria filled the stadium after the goal.
The runners crossed the line in euphoria.
The crowd was euphoric after the win.
She felt euphoric when she saw the surprise.

easy.def: A shout when you find or figure something out.

more.def: A word you shout when you suddenly find or understand something.
examples: "Eureka! I solved it!" cried the scientist.
"Eureka!" she shouted when she found her ring.
He shouted "Eureka!" when he got the answer.

easy.def: The money used in many countries.

more.def: The money used in many countries in Europe.
examples: Many countries in Europe use the euro.
She paid with a euro coin.
